question: In a certain code language, the word 'PARTH' is coded as ‘TEVXL’. What will be the word for code ‘XVEHI’ in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] 

Logic : 

__
 
• (4) is added to each letter's position value.

​So, 

 
• PARTH is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f17f00328623a426fa1dd47ab218d6134cd636dafe8ffe1ee91481484291df8.png] ​

Similarly,

 
• Word for code ‘XVEHI’ - It will reverse i.e instead of adding (4), it will be subtracted.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9300cf8da3926371260a4c0f379a91cb4aa78df09ba535af06d24e66619d8ed6.png] 

Hence, **"TRADE"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__** "XVEHI" is the code itself, and we have to find its root word which is coded as XVEHI.

3e:T
